headline: Constellation Energy Corporation Declares Dividend
summary: BALTIMORE, August 04, 2026--The Board of Directors of Constellation Energy Corporation (Nasdaq: CEG) declared a quarterly dividend of $0.4265 per share on Constellation’s common stock. The dividend is payable on Sept. 4, 2026, to shareholders of record as of 5 p.m. Eastern time on Aug. 18, 2026.

headline: Latest News In Energy Transition - Advantage Renewables Boosts Michigan Grid With Battery Projects
summary: Advantage Renewables has acquired three early-stage battery energy storage system (BESS) projects in Michigan from 5 Rivers Energy, emphasizing the critical role of energy storage in the ongoing energy transition. This strategic acquisition highlights Advantage Renewables' commitment to enhancing grid resilience and integrating renewable resources in the Midwest.
